name: LG
description:
Empirically derived exchangability matrix for general proteins.

This command only refers to the symmetric part of the LG08 model, not the frequencies.  Frequencies are added by using the ` +> F` command.  Frequencies are estimated by default but can be fixed to the values estimated in the paper using ` +> F(LG_freq)`.

citation.title: An Improved General Amino Acid Replacement Matrix
